re_admitted_atoms.claim: gespraech_erinnerung stores id, ts, subject, value and quelle without explicit epistemic/transformation/admission identity fields; row shape alone does not distinguish verbatim claim, summary, inference or verified fact.

The direct conversation-memory reader can append durable_memory matches into the same treffer list and distinguishes them primarily by quelle='durable_memory'; the direct returned context shape does not carry explicit epistemic or transformation class.
Realtime read/write wrappers bridge directly to stern conversation-memory commands without inserting a deterministic epistemic MemoryAdmission layer in the inspected path.

architecture_delta_for_triggerword4.requirement: Introduce typed MemoryCandidate and deterministic MemoryAdmission before persistent conversational-memory mutation, and preserve provenance + transformation_class + epistemic_class through retrieval/context compilation.
architecture_delta_for_triggerword4.invariant: Remembering that somebody said X establishes the memory event/claim provenance, not the world-truth of X. Model Function Calling may propose MemoryCandidate but cannot mint factual authority.

counterboundary: This source result is scoped to the direct Realtime memory path. Other consumers may add stronger epistemic typing and must be audited before repository-wide claims.
recommended_next_gate: Audit all other gespraech_erinnerung/durable_memory consumers for loss or preservation of epistemic/provenance typing, then hand Triggerword 4 a single MemoryCandidate/MemoryAdmission ABI plus structural retrieval-preservation tests.
